lines.cap: The janitor had eight million dollars hidden in his drawers. Well, in his bank box.
lines.say: The janitor had eight million dollars hidden in his drawers. Well, in his bank box.

lines.cap: Ronald Read, from Vermont. He pumped gas for decades, then worked as a janitor.
lines.say: Ronald Read, from Vermont. He pumped gas for decades, then worked as a janitor.

lines.cap: He drove a used car, chopped his own firewood, and held his coat shut with safety pins.
lines.say: He drove a used car, chopped his own firewood, and held his coat shut with safety pins.

lines.cap: But every month, he quietly bought shares in big, boring companies he understood.
lines.say: But every month, he quietly bought shares in big, boring companies he understood.

lines.cap: And he never sold. He just let them grow, for over sixty years.
lines.say: And he never sold. He just let them grow, for over sixty years.

lines.cap: When he died in 2014, at ninety two, his town found out. He'd left almost eight million dollars.
lines.say: When he died in 2014, at ninety two, his town found out. He'd left almost eight million dollars.

lines.cap: Most of it went to the local hospital and library.
lines.say: Most of it went to the local hospital and library.

lines.cap: Rich isn't what you show. It's what you keep.
lines.say: Rich isn't what you show. It's what you keep.
